svg.title: Forty-two served dasha systems collapse into three voices
svg.desc: A bar of 42 systems split into groups: 1 lead star dasha, 9 conditional alternates of which at most the one that applies is used, 1 Tara, 2 that are one sign system, 5 with a stated purpose, 6 popular systems that are not Rath's, 1 fixed by age, 8 for death, illness or curses, and 9 with no stated purpose. For one person this leaves three voices plus up to two purpose dashas.
svg.text: 42 systems are stored for every person

g.text: 1 · Vimshottari. The lead star dasha, for everyone.
9 · Conditional star dashas. Alternates of Vimshottari. Only the one whose condition holds is read.
1 · Tara. Takes Vimshottari's place when four or more planets are in kendras. Not flagged by the engine yet.
2 · Narayana and Chara. One sign system; Chara is its form for a movable lagna. Never two votes.
5 · Sign dashas with a purpose. Sudasa, Drig, Lagnamsaka, Padanadhamsa, Lagna Kendradi. Only for their subject.
6 · Popular, not Rath's. Yogini, Tithi Yogini, Kalachakra, karaka, Kaala, Tithi Ashtottari. Tie-break or in-year only.
1 · Naisargika. Fixed by age. Background, never a trigger.
8 · Death, illness, curses. Shoola, Niryana Shoola, Sthira, Navamsa, Moola, Mandooka, Paryaya, Aayu. Kept out.
9 · No stated purpose in any source. Trikona, Yogardha, Chakra, Varnada and five more. Research only.

svg.text: For one person that leaves three voices:

g.text: Star dasha (Vimshottari, with its one alternate) · Sign dasha (Narayana) · This year (Tithi Pravesha)
plus at most two purpose dashas for the card's subject, such as Sudasa for pay or Narayana cast on the D10.
